answer_2.quote: We use three evaluation metrics: (1) Mean reciprocal rank (MRR) ... (2) Normalized discounted cumulative gain (NDCG@K) ... (3) Recall@K ... In addition, we use another three evaluation metrics: (4) Median Rank (R), (5) Mean Rank (R) and (6) Rank Variance (σ_R).

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on the recommendation results of our method. We randomly select 50 contexts ... and ask annotators to make a binary suitability decision for the quotes. Each quote is annotated by 3 native speakers and the final decision is made by voting.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators make a binary suitability decision for each recommended quote based on whether it fits the given context.
